lines.text: The LORD calls everyone who is thirsty to come to the waters, and those without money to come, buy, and eat.
The LORD promises an everlasting covenant, and His loving devotion was promised to Moses, whom He made a witness to the nations.
The wicked man is told to forsake his way and return to the LORD, who will freely pardon.
The LORD says His ways and thoughts are higher than ours, as the sun is higher than the clouds.

wrong_details.wrong: the sun is higher than the clouds
wrong_details.true: the heavens are higher than the earth

lines.text: The mountains and hills will burst into song, and instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow.
